scope: offline reuse and simulation only; no new physical observations

paper_role.E5: supporting validity check for resolution/reliability/latency constraints
paper_role.E6: core evidence for single-view, estimate-fusion, and stereo information flows
paper_role.E7: repository-only future-work simulation; excluded from manuscript, Appendix, and Supplement

pending_claim_map_rows.claim: Processing the saved 640x400 baseline images already met the predefined 30 Hz latency gate, while offline downsampling to 480x300 reduced complete-frame detection reliability, especially for ihawk1.
pending_claim_map_rows.key_result: native complete detection 100% for both cameras; native worst pipeline P95 8.149 ms; 480x300 complete frames 78.4%/98.8%
pending_claim_map_rows.caveat: not a native sensor-mode experiment; timing is computer-specific

pending_claim_map_rows.claim: Downsampling imposed a camera- and method-dependent accuracy cost and did not reveal a universal height-amplification law.
pending_claim_map_rows.caveat: survivorship after detection failure; same physical images reused

pending_claim_map_rows.claim: Averaging two camera-specific estimates and using calibrated stereo parallax are distinct information flows; the latter added depth information in E6.
pending_claim_map_rows.key_result: PnP at 25 mm ihawk1/ihawk2/equal/LOO = 8.850/4.786/6.057/4.897 mm; stereo XY/Z = 2.752/1.772 mm
pending_claim_map_rows.strength: direct within five paired physical rebuilds
pending_claim_map_rows.caveat: static target; Z=0-derived stereo geometry; no E4 endpoint propagation

pending_claim_map_rows.claim: The existing data do not identify a causal camera-angle effect.
pending_claim_map_rows.key_result: 10 run-camera rows but only 2 fixed placements; all audited geometry ranges are separated by camera identity
pending_claim_map_rows.caveat: pooled correlations are descriptive and confounded

pending_claim_map_rows.claim: In simulation, per-frame relocalization prevented camera motion from making the nominal extrinsic stale.
pending_claim_map_rows.key_result: at 25 mm and 0.5 px noise, frozen-extrinsic PnP reached 40.612 mm under large motion; relocalized PnP stayed 6.623-6.846 mm
pending_claim_map_rows.caveat: no physical motion, detector failure, blur, vibration, rolling shutter, or endpoint validation
